config.design: Eight predeclared domains, two templates each, each with matched repeated-token copying control. Source tokens same across tasks; only source changes across endpoints. No correctness-based pair exclusion. Eligibility jointly requires source/answers single-token and endpoint alignment in all four cells. New combinations/tasks relative to H873, some tokens/templates familiar from prior research; not pretraining-disjoint.
config.gate: Per domain/family/format: >=4 eligible pairs, both-endpoint binary accuracy>=0.75, pooled full-vocabulary top1>=0.5. Allcells and failures retained; no tuning after outcomes.
config.next: Only competent task/copy cell pairs eligible for mechanistic transfer; separately quantify single-example and vocabulary-wide effects. No reservedtest.
